Property and Code Enforcement
801 NORTH FIRST STREET SAN JOSE, CA 95110
HOUSING IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM
CITY OF SAN JOSE
FACT SHEET
BACKGROUND: 
A Housing Improvement Program has been established in designated neighborhoods within the City of San Jose (see attached map) under funds from the U.S. Housing and Community Development Act of 1974. The purpose of the program is to aid property owners in making repairs to single family and two family (duplex) homes.
ELIGIBILITY:
All homeowners and investor-owners within the specified neighborhoods are eligible. Investor-owners must have owned the property for at least six months.
LOW INTEREST LOANS:
1. Available at 3.9% interest with a maximum loan amount of $27,000.
2. Maximum term of loan is 15 years.
3. For qualified low or fixed income individuals, repayment of the loan may be deferred for up to 20 years or until the sale of the house. Interest does not accumulate during this deferral period.
GRANTS: 
1. Owner occupants may be eligible for a grant of up to $3,000, which does not have to be repaid. Gross income, household expenses and family size are considered in computing the amount of the grant.
2. Special Grant. Owner occupants participating in the Loan Program who repair at least $500 worth of housing deficiencies are automatically eligible to receive a $400 grant.
3. Termite inspections are made at no cost to the homeowner.
4. Smoke detectors are provided at no cost to the homeowner.
